# As gun moves from x=0 to x=600:
# A point at x=30 receives spray from x_gun in [0, 130].

# u = x_gun - 30 -> when x_gun=0, u = -30.
# So x_gun in [0, 130] means u in [-30, 100].

def circ_int(a, b):

    return F(b) - F(a)
